versions.subject: net.exe and wmic.exe
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    Image:
        - '*\net.exe'
    CommandLine:
        - 'net group*'
        - 'net localgroup*'
        - 'net user*'
        - 'net view*'
        - 'net share'
        - 'net accounts*'
        - 'net use*'
condition: selection
versions.spl: EventID=1 Image="*\\net.exe" CommandLine IN ("net group*", "net localgroup*", "net user*", "net view*", "net share", "net accounts*", "net use*")

versions.subject: Improved Suspicious Net.exe Execution Rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    Image:
        - '*\net.exe'
        - '*\net1.exe'
    CommandLine:
        - '* group*'
        - '* localgroup*'
        - '* user*'
        - '* view*'
        - '* share'
        - '* accounts*'
        - '* use*'
condition: selection
versions.spl: EventID=1 Image IN ("*\\net.exe", "*\\net1.exe") CommandLine IN ("* group*", "* localgroup*", "* user*", "* view*", "* share", "* accounts*", "* use*")
